class.name: SiEffectAutopan
class.description: Applies a sine LFO to each input channel independently, preserving the stereo input. The stereo width controls the phase difference between the left and right LFOs. A width of 0 modulates both channels together like tremolo; a width of 1 places their LFOs 180 degrees apart.

method.name: set_params
method.description: Sets the LFO frequency in hertz and its stereo phase offset. A [param stereo_width] of 1 is a 180 degree offset.
